name: Portugal Ventures

sources.how: Startup Portugal's "Get ready for Web Summit 2026!" (6 November 2026): named as "Portugal Ventures (BPF)", a partner of the Portugal stand at Web Summit 2026 (Pavilion 1, Stand 145, 10 to 12 November)

Portugal Ventures' own home page, in Portuguese (read 7 November 2026, 20:25 UTC): it invests in technology startups at Pre-Seed, Seed and Series A; 283 million euros under management, 256 new companies and 233.2 million euros invested since 2012, by its own figures
